title: Famous children's books
examples: Which book is about a girl falling down a rabbit hole?
Do The Little Prince and Alice live in the same world?
What kind of animals are in Charlotte's Web?

explain.say: Some children's books are famous all over the world. You will meet three of them.
In Alice in Wonderland, a girl called Alice falls down a rabbit hole. She meets a talking rabbit and a grinning cat.
The Little Prince is about a boy from a tiny planet. He visits other planets and learns about friendship.
Charlotte's Web is about a pig called Wilbur and a spider called Charlotte. Charlotte writes words in her web to help Wilbur.
Lewis Carroll wrote Alice in Wonderland. E. B. White wrote Charlotte's Web. Antoine de Saint-Exupéry wrote The Little Prince.

items: The Little Prince: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

explain.say: When you read, you can picture new places. Some stories make you laugh. Some stories make you think.

draw.text: Books help you picture new places

faq.q: What is The Little Prince about?
faq.a: It is about a little boy who travels to different planets. He learns important lessons about what really matters in life and friendship.
asks: What is the meaning of The Little Prince?
Does The Little Prince talk about planets?

faq.q: Are the characters in these books real animals?
faq.a: They are made-up characters. Some are animals that talk, like Wilbur the pig and Charlotte the spider.
asks: Are the creatures in the books real?
Do the animals talk in these stories?

faq.q: Which book is the most popular?
faq.a: It is hard to say which is the most popular book. Everyone loves a different story for a different reason.
asks: Is one book better than the others?
Which story should I read first?

faq.q: Do I need to read them in order?
faq.a: No, you can read them in any order you like. Each book tells its own wonderful story to enjoy.
asks: Do I read them like a series?
Is there a right order to read them?

faq.q: Are these books for grown-ups too?
faq.a: Yes, many grown-ups love reading them too. The lessons in the stories are for all ages to enjoy.
asks: Are these books only for children?

facts: Alice in Wonderland was written by Lewis Carroll.
The Little Prince was written by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry.
Charlotte's Web, by E. B. White, is about the friendship between Wilbur the pig and Charlotte the spider.

quiz.say: Think of a girl who falls down a rabbit hole. Tap the book.
quiz.why: In Alice in Wonderland, Alice falls down a rabbit hole into a strange land.

wrong.0: Charlotte's Web is about a pig and a spider on a farm.
wrong.2: The Little Prince is about a boy from a tiny planet.

quiz.say: Think of The Little Prince. Tap what the story is about.
quiz.why: The Little Prince learns that friends and love matter most.

wrong.1: The prince travels to meet others, and there is no treasure to find.
wrong.2: The prince cares for a rose and a fox, and strength plays no part.

quiz.say: Think of a spider who helps her friend, a pig. Tap the book.
quiz.why: In Charlotte's Web, Charlotte the spider helps Wilbur the pig.

wrong.0: Peter Rabbit is about a rabbit who goes into a garden.
wrong.1: Alice in Wonderland is about a girl in a strange land.
